name: Galette Dough
summary: Rustic free-form tart base. Sturdy enough to hold fruit.

steps.text: Rub in butter leaving flat sheets rather than crumbs.
Add water, bring together, chill one hour.
Roll a rough round, pile fruit centre, fold the edge over.
Chill again before baking to set the folds.

bake.notes: A layer of ground nuts under the fruit stops a soggy base.

notes: Flat butter sheets give the flaky layers here.
